remarks: Sun-drenched two-Story condo in the coveted Chesterfield Complex - 2289 Bedford Street. Discover refined condo living in one of the area's most sought-after communities. This stunning 1-bedroom, 2-bath residence spans two beautifully designed floors, flooded with natural light from every angle to create a warm, airy atmosphere throughout. Inside, you'll find a tastefully updated kitchen and renovated bathrooms, blending modern style with everyday functionality. Step outside to your private deck - the perfect spot for morning coffee, evening unwinding, or entertaining friends under the open sky. The convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer adds to the home's effortless appeal. Living in Chesterfield means more than just a beautiful home. Residents enjoy resort-style amenities including a sparkling community pool, an inviting clubhouse, and the peace of mind that comes with 24-hour security. Whether you're seeking a stylish primary residence or a turnkey getaway, 2289 Bedford Street offers the perfect combination of comfort, luxury, and lifestyle.
